questions.question: Compare the major theories of entrepreneurship and explain how each provides a different explanation of entrepreneurial behaviour. / [CO2]
questions.solution_html:
• Compare the major theories of entrepreneurship and explain how each provides a different
  • explanation of entrepreneurial behaviour.
  • Entrepreneurship theories explain why individuals become entrepreneurs and how entrepreneurial behaviour
  • contributes to economic development.
  • Theory Major Proponent Explanation
  • Innovation Theory Joseph A. Schumpeter
  • Entrepreneurs introduce innovations such as new
  • products, production methods, markets and
  • organisational forms.
  • Risk-Bearing Theory Frank H. Knight Entrepreneurs undertake uncertainty and earn profit as a reward for bearing uninsurable risks.
  • Uncertainty-Bearing
  • Theory Richard Cantillon Entrepreneurs purchase resources at known prices and sell products at uncertain prices.
  • Need for Achievement
  • Theory David McClelland Individuals with a strong need for achievement are more likely to become entrepreneurs.
  • Sociological Theory Max Weber Social values, culture and religious beliefs influence entrepreneurial behaviour.
  • These theories explain entrepreneurship from different perspectives, including innovation, risk, uncertainty,
  • psychological motivation and social environment.
  • (Note: Students may present equivalent answers with suitable examples)
